reply.text: That's a normal thing to notice at your age, and bodies grow on their own schedule, so being smaller than your friends right now says nothing about how strong you can get. For a twelve-year-old, I'd keep it simple: play sports, do things like push-ups, pull-ups, and bodyweight squats, learn good form first, and sleep and eat well. Building a program or getting big is one to talk through with a parent and your doctor first, and once you've done that I'm glad to help with the training side. Who knows, you may beat them all at pull-ups before they've even tried.
